meta.title: di-segmentation · LRO Front, Worker, Python Compute
meta.subtitle: MLE · system dia · ML tooth and anatomy segmentation for dental imaging

views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: Compute, GetOperation and WaitOperation on port 50051. WaitOperation is capped at 10 minutes.

views.label: Claim and compute
views.note: The worker claims one row, keeps the lease alive, then calls the Python sidecar over localhost:50071.

views.label: Inside the worker pod
views.note: This family retries only 3 times, but backs off between attempts instead of sleeping a flat second.

cards.title: One of the few that kept the -lro suffix
items: Most dia families dropped it; di-segmentation-lro still names the front explicitly
main.go supplies only serviceName, validateRequest and a whitelist
The Deployment is contributed by k8s/postgres-lro-patch/lro, not by this directory

cards.title: A different retry policy
items: computeRetries is 3 here, not the 15 used by ai-scan-orientation and tooth-recognition
The loop sleeps a computed backoffDuration rather than a flat one second
Only codes.Unavailable is retried; any other error fails the work item immediately

cards.title: A large resident model
items: The sidecar requests 17Gi outright and may burst to 25Gi against a 5 CPU limit
The Go container stays at 1 CPU and 1024Mi, as in every other family
Both land on the MLE node pool via the nodeType=mle:NoSchedule toleration

cards.title: Operations
items: LRO duration threshold is 60s under opdoc DIA-015; the worker is DIA-018
The CODEOWNERS row for di-segmentation-storage is stale, no such directory exists
